title: DOW-UAP-PR113, Unresolved UAP Report, Western United States, 1996
what_is_it: A US military video record (infrared sensor footage) of an unresolved UAP incident, transferred to AARO and released as part of the war.gov/UFO PURSUE collection.
interpretation_warnings: No source text could be extracted from the PDF; all facts derive from war.gov metadata and the official video description, not from independent analysis.
The government states the video was digitally altered before it was reported, so the imagery is not an unmodified original.
No formal data-handling practices for UAP records existed when this media was reported, limiting provenance certainty.
The 'area of contrast' is described only as an unresolved anomaly; the source does not identify it as any specific object.
Much of the runtime is repeated or looped footage of the same brief 17-second event, so the apparent length overstates the unique content.
Single-source government record with no named observer or corroborating documentation in the provided material.
